description: champagne problems is a top 5 Taylor song and I will fight anyone who disagrees 😤🔥 'She would've made such a lovely bride, what a shame she's fucked in the head' is DEVASTATING. The whole rejected proposal story is pure poetry and I cry every time the bridge hits. It's the kind of song that ruins your whole day in the best way. Mother's storytelling at its absolute peak 💅😭
